localizedCardText: Space Weather Laboratory UC San Diego researchers contribute to space, balloon, and ground-based instrumentation to study solar physics and space weather . This includes radio observatories operated by Nagoya University in Japan; LOFAR, operated by Astron in The Netherlands; and the MWA, a pathfinder for SKA in Australia. In space, facilities include the NASA STEREO spacecraft, the ESA/NASA Solar Orbiter, the ESA/JAXA BepiColombo, and NASA's Parker Solar Probe. PI: Dr. Bernard Jackson
